answer: The cheapest real defence: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because violet only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, hollow is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any sparrow approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
